_comment: AI-Assisted: Claude Code (model: claude-opus-5) - Authored per 004 data-model.md §4 (004 task T014), for curation/composition-overrides.json. Keyed (datasheet_id, line). Mirrors curation/resolutions.json's existing pattern: curator-written, carried forward, validated on read, never written by any pipeline stage. An entry naming a datasheet, line, or model that does not exist is the blocking AUT-DANGLING-REF -- 002's authored-reference integrity check extended, not reimplemented. THIS FILE IS THE ESCAPE HATCH THAT MAKES 'NEVER GUESS' AFFORDABLE: without it the 1.3% composition tail would be a permanent defect; with it it is a bounded, one-time, carry-forward cost, which is exactly how 002 made ability summaries tractable. AI-Assisted: Claude Code (model: claude-sonnet-5) - Added the `remove` shape (007, Product Owner decision 2026-08-14 T061 review): when the automatic CMP-HEADER-ROW refusal was demoted to advisory-only, curator removal via this file became the only way a phantom composition row leaves a published datasheet. A `remove` entry carries none of the replacement fields.
title: curation/composition-overrides.json

remove.description: When true, this line is removed from the published composition entirely -- no model_name/min_count/max_count/model_line permitted. When absent or false, the row is replaced and all three of model_name/min_count/max_count are required, exactly as before this field existed.

max_count.description: Equal to min_count for a fixed count, which is the majority shape and is never 'missing data'.

note.description: A curator's sentence about MECHANICS OR PROCESS. It must not quote source text.
